sources.collection_scope: Commercial Building and Electrical Permits: rolling 30-day issuance / 7-day status changes, plus literal data center/data centre and construction power/temporary service/t-pole initial backfill issued 2026-01-01 through 2026-09-30, rechecked within the same counted query.
sources.coverage_limitation: City limits only; literal-keyword backfill is not all data-center work. Older status changes outside the overlap or fixed backfill are not comprehensively monitored. Permit-listed names and permit-listed phones do not establish current employment or buying authority.

sources.collection_scope: Bounded 90-day issued-permit window, all permit types/statuses; count-checked deterministic pagination ordered by issue timestamp and row ID.
sources.coverage_limitation: Not the full 664,565-row history. Closed/completed records remain evidence and are not admitted as current Signals. Applicant is not a buyer role. No construction start, project owner, temporary rental need, MW, supply gap, or authority is inferred; declared valuation and area are not power need. Status changes on records outside the recent issue window are not monitored.

sources.collection_scope: CEQA documents received in the last 60 days with an Industrial, Power or Other development type; document pages are read (bounded per run) and kept only when the title or description names a data center.
sources.coverage_limitation: Only CEQA filings; projects exempt from CEQA or filed under another development type are missed. When more documents arrive than the per-run bound, ones naming a data center only in their description can be missed. A CEQA filing is environmental review, not construction.

sources.collection_scope: Chicago new construction, renovation/alteration and Express Electrical Work permits; 30-day issue window plus 2-day modification overlap; scope, full address, parcel, application start, permit milestone and named party roles retained.
sources.coverage_limitation: Chicago status monitoring uses the official Socrata :updated_at row timestamp with a two-day overlap. Longer outages can miss changes; a dataset-wide replacement may exceed the bounded row limit and will fail visibly. Express Electrical Work includes small and residential work; inclusion in collection does not guarantee Signal admission. No dedicated procurement or commissioning coverage.

sources.collection_scope: Four most recent weekly XLSX reports linked on official Sold Permits Search page; all rows in those workbooks. Permit Date represents a Sold (approved) event, not current lifecycle or report publication time. Exact public detail enrichment is limited to exact-project Building Pmt results (PT=13).
sources.coverage_limitation: As retrieved 2026-10-01, four reports contain 1,543 rows (1,422 Building Pmt, 112 Demolition, 9 OCC-BLDG PMT). Latest link Sept 7-13 is 317 rows, workbook header reads From 2026/09/07 and To 2026/09/14, observed Permit Dates are 2026-09-08..13, and core metadata created/modified is 2026-09-14T16:43:22Z. The weekly range convention treats the To date as exclusive, though the workbook does not label it exclusive. On Oct 1 the latest sale date was 18 calendar days old and the report period end 17 days old. These internal dates do not verify publication time; source publication timestamp and lag are UNKNOWN. Weekly sheets have no party fields. Exact search detail returns role-specific Buyer, combined Owner/Occupant, buyer address and phone; person/company kind, phone ownership, current work and authority remain UNKNOWN. Not complete sold-permit history, electrical or commissioning coverage. Reports older than 30 days fail visibly; earlier revisions outside four reports are not monitored.

sources.coverage_limitation: Seattle exposes no per-row status-change date; Socrata :updated_at was refreshed across 193257 rows in the same recent interval, so it is not a reliable row-change signal. Older permit status edits are not monitored by this discovery query. Remedy: add a bounded worker query for previously retained active permit IDs or a source lifecycle feed.

sources.coverage_limitation: Bounded rolling Taylor CivicPlus Development News/Notices categories 30/31 archive lookback with configured overlap; no atomic upstream snapshot is available.

sources.collection_scope: All framed permit groups in current daf420.dat plus previous calendar month official end-of-month snapshot. One permit identity; lowest sequence is newest amendment. Older retained entities are never deleted by snapshot absence.
sources.coverage_limitation: Not all historical Texas permits. No pending-application feed or older-month correction monitoring. Outages longer than the prior-month overlap can miss activity. Current file over four days old, missing previous-month EOM, changed framing, or bounds fail visibly. Production date, load, fuel suitability, rental demand and contacts are UNKNOWN.

sources.collection_scope: Complete count-checked SWR 32 application result set for the prior three calendar days by submittal date, paged at 10 rows with a 50-page/500-record bound.
sources.coverage_limitation: Applications for exceptions only, not flaring/venting measurements. Rule 32 also permits some flaring without an exception application. Public query excludes pre-2021-05-02 online-system filings; older filings outside the three-day submittal window are not rechecked for status changes and no historical backfill is included. Application details and authorization documents are not fetched. Physical flare/vent site, requested volume, gas composition, continuous flow, generator fit, MW, rental demand, buyer, and buying authority remain UNKNOWN.

sources.collection_scope: All rows of the statewide pending NSR application listing; Plain Language Summary PDFs fetched only for data-center or power-generation filings, newest first, bounded per run.
sources.coverage_limitation: Pending NSR case-by-case applications only; permits by rule and standard permits are not in this listing. TCEQ began moving pending-application publishing to its Permit Search Portal on August 31, 2026, so this listing may thin out. Summaries give site and purpose but rarely MW; proposed onsite generation is proposed supply, not adequate power.

sources.collection_scope: Temporary concrete batch plant registrations on the statewide pending-permit summaries page; the Notice of Application and Preliminary Decision PDF is fetched for each, bounded per run.
sources.coverage_limitation: Only applications still in TCEQ's public notice window. Registrations appear here briefly; earlier notices are not backfilled. The batch plant operator is a materials supplier, not the project owner or GC.

sources.collection_scope: Statewide TABS registrations in the last 90 days whose project name matches a data-center term, with each project page read for county, developer-reported dates, cost, scope and owner. Covers unincorporated county land.
sources.coverage_limitation: Only projects of $50,000 or more registered with TDLR, matched by project name; projects named without a data-center term are missed. Start and completion dates and cost are the registrant's estimates. Registration is accessibility review, not a building permit.
